question: From October 1,2025 SEBI’s new framework caps the net intraday position in equity index options at what limit per entity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5,000 crore rupees.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has introduced a new monitoring framework for intraday positions in equity index derivatives.**
 
• **Effective from October 1, the net intraday position is capped at 5,000 crore rupees per entity in index options.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Net intraday cap: 5,000 crore rupees per entity in index options.**
 
• **Earlier end-of-day position limit: 1,500 crore rupees.**
 
• **Gross intraday limit remains unchanged at 10,000 crore rupees.**
 
• **SEBI aims to curb excessive risk-taking and strengthen market stability.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Monitoring Mechanism**__

 __
 
• Stock exchanges will track intraday positions using at least four random snapshots daily.
 
• One snapshot must be taken during peak market hours (2:45 pm to 3:30 pm).
 
 
 
• **Compliance Measures**__
 __
 
• Breaches will lead to scrutiny, penalties, or additional surveillance deposits.
 
 
 
• **Objective**__
 __
 
• Enhance oversight of large exposures in equity index derivatives.
 
• Ensure orderly market functioning and reduce systemic risks.
 
 
 
• **Background**__
 
 
• SEBI is India’s securities market regulator, ensuring transparency, investor protection, and fair practices.
